evals.expected_output: Only one (status) entry exists per account in the ledger, with exact format compliance
expectations: Existing (status) entry in ledger found and replaced (not duplicated)
New (status) entry placed at top of ledger (line 2, after # Deal Ledger) if none existed
Ledger entry format MUST be: '- M/D INITIALS (status): {emoji} {concise update}'
The marker MUST be '(status)' — NOT '(weekly review)', NOT 'Weekly review', NOT any other label
Health emoji MUST be present: 🟢 (Green), 🟡 (Yellow), or 🔴 (Red)
Update text is max ~20 words after the emoji — no deal amounts, close dates, or forecast
Salesforce Updates section in account .md file has matching (status) entry at top of code block
SF Updates entry uses same format: '- M/D INITIALS (status): {emoji} {concise update}'
Only ONE (status) entry per file — no duplicates in Ledger.md or account .md
Regular deal activity entries (e.g. '- 3/20 GY: Demo with VP Eng') do NOT get (status) marker

evals.prompt: /sales-weekly (bad opp URL auto-fix: salesforce_opportunity contains Account URL)
evals.expected_output: Detects Account URL in opportunity field, queries Salesforce for open opps, fixes frontmatter
expectations: salesforce_opportunity field containing /Account/ URL detected as bad opp URL
Account ID extracted from the URL
Salesforce queried: SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity WHERE AccountId AND IsClosed = false
If one open opp found: salesforce_opportunity updated with correct Opportunity URL
If multiple open opps found: primary set to first, extras added as salesforce_opportunity_2, etc.
If no open opps found: salesforce_opportunity cleared
Bad Account URL moved to salesforce_account if that field was empty
Account re-categorized after fix

evals.expected_output: Each open opportunity scored as Green/Yellow/Red with justification, pushed to Salesforce if configured
expectations: Each open opportunity evaluated across multiple signals: last meeting date, champion engagement, MEDDPICC completeness, stage velocity, close date movement, stakeholder breadth, technical validation, competitive pressure, next steps clarity
Score is Green (progressing well), Yellow (1-2 risk signals), or Red (multiple risk signals)
One-line justification written (max ~15 words)
Health color appended to ledger status entry as emoji (green/yellow/red circle)
If salesforce_deal_health_field configured: PATCH sent to Salesforce for each open opp
Deal Risk Radar section in report shows Red first, then Yellow, then Green

evals.prompt: /sales-weekly (status entry format compliance across all accounts)
evals.expected_output: Every account's ledger and SF Updates section uses exact (status) format with no variations
expectations: Format is exactly: '- M/D INITIALS (status): {emoji} {text}' — no variations
NEVER use '(weekly review)' or 'Weekly review' or '(weekly)' as the marker
NEVER omit the health emoji (🟢/🟡/🔴) from the status entry
NEVER write status entries longer than ~20 words after the emoji
NEVER write two (status) entries in the same file (Ledger.md or account .md)
The Ledger.md and account .md Salesforce Updates entries must match
Subagents instructed with explicit format requirements in their prompts
After subagents complete, a format audit pass verifies all entries
Any format violations found by audit are auto-corrected before final report
